newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MALAYSIAN KING BEGINS FOUR-DAY VISIT TO HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIAN KING BEGINS FOUR-DAY VISIT TO HUNGARY.

text.p: Malaysian King Tuanku Ja'afar began a four-day official visit to Hungary on Tuesday in the latest in a series of diplomatic contacts designed to boost trade and political links between the two countries.
Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn and Parliamentary speaker Zoltan Gal have both visited Malaysia in the last year and expressed their desire to diversify Hungary's trade links outside Europe.

Talks on Tuesday between the king and Hungarian President Arpad Goncz ranged from ways of reducing Hungary's $40 million trade deficit to developments in neighbouring former Yugoslavia, where Malaysia has the largest non-NATO peacekeeping comntingent, Hungarian news agency MTI reported.
On Wednesday the king will be given the keys to Budapest by the city's major Gabor Demszky.
